headline: 英倫影劇評論二則
context: 劇評兩則：影集《You're Killing Me》由布魯克·雪德絲（Brooke Shields）主演，飾演暢銷推理小說家，評論認為劇情有點懶惰，但已確定續訂第二季。舞台劇《Wiping My Mother's Arse》在蘇格蘭皮特洛赫里藝術節劇院上演至9月5日，描寫安養院裡的照護糾葛與金錢猜忌，被評好笑但輕重段落略顯不搭。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: I desperately wanted this show to be Gilmore Girls meets Murder, She Wrote – but the story of a novelist turned amateur sleuth is just so lazy. And yet, I still have high hopes for the confirmed second season Look, we all want Brooke Shields to be in gainful employment. We all want her to have a fabulous third act to her career. God knows, the child model turned star of prurient fever dreams Pretty Baby and The Blue Lagoon (and the “Nothing comes between me and my Calvins” jeans ad campaign when she was 15) has earned it. Plus, she did a fine turn in Friends and a number of us remember Suddenly Susan very fondly. But she’s terrible in the terrible new thing she’s in, which is a six-part comedy drama called You’re Killing Me. Shields plays successful cosy mystery novelist Allison Chandler, who lives in the picturesque town of Founder’s Cove, Maine. It’s Murder, She Wrote vibes all right, but please lower your expectations. Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Pitlochry Festival theatre Iain Heggie’s rejigged 2001 play – now ensconced in the world of voice notes and vapes – is very funny, but the lighter moments jar with some sobering subtexts These days, shows about care homes, dementia and end of life are very common, but when Iain Heggie’s splendidly named Wiping My Mother’s Arse premiered in 2001 , it was ahead of the curve. It is set in an overstretched nursing home where Andrene (Anne Kidd) has developed a close relationship with her care worker, Larry (Johnny McKnight), little realising he previously spent five years living with her son, Derek (David Rankine). Cue the comedy of confusion and subterfuge. The play’s fault line runs through questions of care, compassion and money. The emotionally detached Derek has been happy to farm out the care of his mother while he lives at the other end of the country. He shows less interest in her welfare than he does in her bank account. At Pitlochry Festival theatre until 5 September Continue reading...

thread_text:
英倫影劇評論二則

《衛報》劇評：布魯克·雪德絲主演犯罪喜劇《You're Killing Me》被評劇情有點懶惰，但已確定續訂第二季。舞台劇《Wiping My Mother's Arse》於蘇格蘭皮特洛赫里藝術節劇院演出至9月5日，描寫安養院裡的照護糾葛，被評好笑但輕重段落略顯不搭。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月發佈。
threads_text:
英倫影劇評論二則

影集方面，《衛報》評論布魯克·雪德絲主演的犯罪喜劇《You're Killing Me》劇情有點懶惰，不過已經確定要拍第二季，評論人仍抱期待。舞台劇方面，蘇格蘭皮特洛赫里藝術節劇院重新製作《Wiping My Mother's Arse》，故事設在安養院，演出被形容很好笑，但輕鬆段落與劇中沉重主題略顯不搭，演出至9月5日。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月發佈的報導。
voice_text: 這次的藝文版有兩則評論。先看影集，布魯克·雪德絲（Brooke Shields）主演的六集喜劇《You're Killing Me》，她演的是住在虛構小鎮的暢銷推理小說家。劇情被說有點懶惰，不過已經確定要拍第二季，評論人還是抱著期待。舞台劇這邊，蘇格蘭的皮特洛赫里藝術節劇院，重新製作了《Wiping My Mother's Arse》，故事發生在一間人手吃緊的安養院，主角和照護員之間發展出親近關係，卻不知道對方跟自己兒子曾同居五年，牽出一連串誤會和暗中角力。劇情核心圍繞照顧、情感和金錢，兒子把母親的照顧全丟給別人，卻對她的銀行帳戶比對她的健康更上心。演出被形容很好笑，但輕鬆的段落跟劇裡沉重的主題有點不搭，演出到9月5日為止。
